30-§ 195.563 Which pipelines must have cathodic protection?
31-(a) Each buried or submerged pipeline that is constructed, relocated, replaced, or
32-otherwise changed after the applicable date in § 195.401(c) must have cathodic
33-protection. The cathodic protection must be in operation not later than 1 year
34-after the pipeline is constructed, relocated, replaced, or otherwise changed, as
35-applicable.

37-At the time of the inspection, Grayson did not have cathodic protection installed on any of its 10
38-one-thousand-barrel capacity breakout tanks located at the Williams Booster Station. The
39-Williams Booster Station tanks were constructed in 2017 and did not have cathodic protection
40-installed within one year of construction. By failing to provide cathodic protection on its
41-breakout tanks, Grayson failed to follow the requirements of § 195.563(a).
